Un vrai terminal dans un onglet de NeoDe: A real terminal in a NeoDex tab: PowerShell, PowerShell 7, Command Prompt, Git Bash or WSL (whichever are installed), with the shell's own colors, prompt and history; full-screen programs like vim, htop or ssh work. Several terminals in tabs (+ button, Ctrl+Shift+T, Ctrl+Shift+W to close), the size follows the window, Ctrl+C copies when text is selected and Ctrl+V pastes. Nothing is saved. Needs NeoDex 3.4.2; before that, or if the Windows pseudo console is missing, the old line-by-line terminal takes over.
